payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the current state-of-the-art models and their performance on the WSJ dataset, including comparisons of Word Error Rates (WER) and methodologies used.

claims.text: The current best model on WSJ is an HMM-based system that combines convolutional, recurrent, and fully connected layers, achieving the lowest WER.
The best end-to-end system trained only on WSJ uses lattice-free MMI on augmented data and achieves a competitive WER.
Replacing the n-gram language model with a convolutional one improves the WER, making the model comparable to the best end-to-end system.
